correctness.rationale: Every finite Boolean algebra of size ≤4 has no proper nontrivial f-stable subalgebra carrying a nontrivial congruence; hence each unary expansion has CEP. On the eight-element Boolean algebra the explicit normal monotone extensive idempotent f=(0,1,2,3,4,7,7,7) fixes C={0,4,3,7}, whose partition {0,4}|{3,7} can extend only via kernel K=4; global f(1)=1 and f(5)=7 violate this kernel (1 xor 5=4 but 1 xor 7=6). Independently implemented a fresh C congruence-based enumeration of all 8^8=16,777,216 unary maps, all f-stable Boolean subalgebras, local/global Boolean-kernel congruences and all six S3 conjugacy fixed-point counts; reproduced exactly 1,216,800 failures, 205,724 failure orbits, 2,804,480 total orbits, 45 closure operations, 13 closure failures, four failure orbits. Fixed-point failure counts 1,216,800 (identity), 5,832 for each transposition and 24 for each 3-cycle; closure fixed failure counts 13,3,1. Independent replay of /tmp/independent_cep completed successfully, agreeing with inspected Git verify.c, rather than trusting its VERIFY_OK.
